summary: British American Tobacco filed a Form 6-K containing three press releases disclosing routine PDMR share transactions. The filings report acquisitions of ordinary shares by executives via dividend reinvestment under the Deferred Share Bonus Scheme and Share Incentive Plan, including CEO Tadeu Marroco's purchases at £42.14 and £42.15 per share. These are standard notifications of managerial dealings, not a special situation. No M&A, tender offer, restructuring, or strategic action is involved. The filing is purely administrative, satisfying UK MAR and SEC disclosure obligations; there is no investment angle or event to monitor.
